mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (current monthly level below prior month's level) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (both above their 3-month moving averages) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high industrial production growth (year-over-year growth exceeding 1.5%), robust manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO growth > 1.5% yoy, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL yoy growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly GDP growth rate (as reported in the latest release) signals strong economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) and moderate CPI inflation (year-over-year growth above 1.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL yoy growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.
